ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) to 25% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Prominent low-intensity vertical column extending from the peduncle toward the notch. Contiguous dark pigmentation is concentrated along the entire trailing edge and distal tips, with discrete dark mottling and clusters distributed asymmetrically across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 80 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with varying pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire span; a distinct larger secondary indentation is visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral sweep characterized by a slight upward concavity on the trailing edge terminating in tapered, posteriorly-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle attachment scars) are localized on the dark-pigmented distal tips, particularly the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, oriented semi-vertically against the high-intensity background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant secondary traumatic notch is visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy dark pigmentation/scarring is present at the peduncle insertion point.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip exhibits an exceptionally jagged, fringed serration pattern compared to the smoother leading edges.
